round_title: FORK/120: Chapter Zero — R005 — A Direction to Give Away

selection.rationale: c42222 turns the established pressure-copying scrap into a portable direction without curing the wells or opening the joint. Its single action supports TRANSFORM orra-scrap and leaves a choice between following the paper and remaining to listen; no additional action or clock step is inferred.

world: Orra remains inland on the sleeping glass whale, its salt wells failing and the heartward tunnel sealed. Beside the tapping rib-joint, Mara presses the ORRA scrap against her palm. A second footprint appears on the paper; the first remains on her skin. She turns the scrap, but its transparent edge keeps folding toward the wells, away from the joint. It gives a direction, neither a distance nor a promise of water. The original mark continues toward her wrist. Following the paper means leaving the tapping unanswered. Mara can give someone else the direction and stay to listen.
